packageRules.description: Exclude all @assistant-ui packages from automated updates
Keep Lexical aligned with @assistant-ui/react-lexical until the adapter supports newer releases

@sentry/react and @sentry/bundler-plugins must match the @sentry/core version pinned by @sentry/electron (the renderer passes react's init into electron's init; bundler-plugins keeps a single core in the repo). Never bump them on their own; bump them by hand in the @sentry/electron PR.
Remind the reviewer to align @sentry/react and @sentry/bundler-plugins in the same PR.
prBodyNotes: Set `@sentry/react` and `@sentry/bundler-plugins` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` to the `@sentry/core` version listed in https://unpkg.com/@sentry/electron@{{{newVersion}}}/package.json, then run `pnpm install`. CI typecheck fails until react matches. If `@sentry/vite-plugin` has published that same version, switch back to it (see the note in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`).

packageRules.description: Update all bundled Kilo CLI platform packages together for manual compatibility testing.
Automatically merge minor and patch updates for GitHub Actions.
Ensure lock file maintenance PRs are never throttled

lockFileMaintenance.description: Regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml. Manual merge: native addons (electron, better-sqlite3, keytar) can break on lockfile-only bumps.
